original.statement: The Open Policy Agent authorization (`type: opa` on the Kafka resource's authorization type field) has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release; the Open Policy Agent authorizer can be used through `type: custom` authorization instead.

decision.reason: [ev-b55698b84a79] deprecates authorization `type: opa` and points to `type: custom` as the replacement. Only environments that set the authorization type to opa are exposed. The CRD schema validator confirmed that kafka.strimzi.io Kafka spec.kafka.authorization.type exists in both releases [ev-5d73e704055d][ev-d758a7cb99a4]. That makes a Kafka resource with this field equal to "opa" the right exposure, with no overlap needed. The changelog line does not name the resource kind or the field path itself; those come from the schema check, so confidence is low.
